The "best" endgame build in *Dark Souls Remastered* depends on your playstyle, but some of the most powerful and versatile builds for PvE and PvP include:

### **Top Endgame Builds (SL 120-125 Meta for PvP)**
#### **1. Strength Build (High Poise, High Damage)**
- **Weapons:**
  - **Great Club** (Stagger machine, S-tier for PvE)
  - **Demon’s Greataxe** (Highest AR for Strength)
  - **Black Knight Greatsword** (Bleed + High Damage)
  - **Zweihander** (R2s, great moveset)
  - **Greatsword (Claymore)** (Versatile, good for PvP)
- **Stats (SL 120):**
  - **Vitality:** 40 (for poise & equip load)
  - **Endurance:** 40 (stamina & defense)
  - **Strength:** 50 (40 base + 10 from Ring)
  - **Dexterity:** 16 (minimum for some weapons)
  - **Faith/Intelligence:** Base (unless using Buffs)
- **Rings:**
  - **Ring of Favor and Protection**
  - **Wolf Ring** (Poise)
  - **Havel’s Ring +2** (Equip Load)
  - **Ring of the Sun’s First Born** (If using Strength miracles)
- **Armor:**
  - **Black Iron Set** (High poise, fashion)
  - **Havel’s Set** (Max poise, heavy)
  - **Giant’s Set** (Tank mode)
- **Best for:** PvE (bosskilling), Tanky PvP, Staggering opponents

---

#### **2. Dexterity Build (Bleed, Fast Attacks, Criticals)**
- **Weapons:**
  - **Uchigatana** (Bleed, great moveset)
  - **Iato** (Bleed + Chaos upgrade for extra damage)
  - **Hornet Ring + Chaos/Dark Uchi** (50+ Bleed buildup)
  - **Rgele’s Rapier** (Best critical damage)
  - **Estoc** (Fast, low stamina cost, great for PvP)
  - **Scimitar/Falcion** (Bleed, curved sword moveset)
- **Stats (SL 120):**
  - **Vitality:** 30-35
  - **Endurance:** 40
  - **Dexterity:** 45-50 (Scales well with Chaos/Dark upgrades)
  - **Strength:** 16-18 (for weapon requirements)
  - **Luck:** 40+ (If focusing on Bleed/Hollow infusions)
- **Rings:**
  - **Hornet Ring** (Boosts ripostes)
  - **Leo Ring** (Boosts counter damage)
  - **Prisoner’s Chain** (Extra stats)
  - **Chloranthy Ring** (Stamina regen)
- **Armor:**
  - **Thief’s Set** (Light, good fashion)
  - **Sunless Set** (Bleed synergy if using Luck)
- **Best for:** PvP (parry builds, bleed spam), Fast PvE (backstabs, quick attacks)

---

#### **3. Intelligence Build (Magic Sorcery, High Burst Damage)**
- **Weapons:**
  - **Moonlight Greatsword (MLGS)** (Melee + Ranged, scales with Int)
  - **Crystal Magic Weapon (CMW) Buffed Weapons** (Uchigatana, Rapier, etc.)
  - **Enchanted Weapons (Bounding Demon’s Greataxe, etc.)**
- **Spells:**
  - **Soul Spear** (Best high-damage spell)
  - **Homing Soulmass** (Great for PvP tracking)
  - **Great Soul Arrow** (Staggering)
- **Stats (SL 120):**
  - **Vitality:** 25-30
  - **Endurance:** 30-35
  - **Intelligence:** 50 (45 with Sage Ring)
  - **Attunement:** 30-40 (For FP & spell slots)
  - **Dexterity:** 18 (for minimum weapon reqs)
- **Rings:**
  - **Sage Ring +2** (More spell casts)
  - **Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring** (+20% magic damage)
  - **Magic Clutch Ring** (If not using Yorshka’s Chime)
  - **Prisoner’s Chain** (Extra stats)
- **Armor:**
  - **Sage’s Big Hat + Crown of Dusk** (Max magic damage)
  - **Logan’s Set** (Fashion)
- **Best for:** PvE (melting bosses), PvP (spam Soul Spear, CMW buffed weapons)

---

#### **4. Faith Build (Miracles, Buffs, Hexes)**
- **Weapons:**
  - **Sunlight Blade Buffed Weapons** (Any Strength/Dex weapon with high AR)
  - **Divine/Blessed Weapons** (Scaling with Faith)
  - **Darkinfused Weapons** (For Hexes)
- **Spells:**
  - **Sunlight Blade** (Best melee buff)
  - **Great Lightning Spear** (High damage)
  - **Wrath of the Gods** (Anti-gank)
  - **Dark Bead** (Hex, high damage)
- **Stats (SL 120):**
  - **Vitality:** 30-35
  - **Endurance:** 30-35
  - **Faith:** 50 (45 with Sage Ring)
  - **Strength/Dexterity:** Enough for weapon (e.g., 24 Str / 18 Dex for Claymore)
  - **Attunement:** 30-40 (For FP & spells)
- **Rings:**
  - **Sunlight Maggot** (Hypermode for Sunlight Blade)
  - **Morbide Ring** (More FP)
  - **Darkmoon Ring** (If using Hexes)
  - **Ring of the Sun’s First Born** (Boosts sunlight spells)
- **Armor:**
  - **Sunlight Set** (Fashion + miracle synergy)
  - **Cleric Set**
- **Best for:** PvE (buffed weapons destroy bosses), PvP (Sunlight Blade + WotG pressure)

---

#### **5. Pyromancy Build (Balanced Magic + Melee)**
- **Weapons:**
  - **Onion Bro Sword (Flame Stoneplate Ring + Chaos/Dark infusion)**
  - **Chaos/Dark Greatsword of Artorias** (High AR with buffs)
  - **Pyromancy Flame (Max Upgrade)**
- **Spells:**
  - **Black Flame** (Best for PvP, combos into melee)
  - **Great Combustion** (High burst damage)
  - **Great Chaos Fireball** (Best PvE spell)
- **Stats (SL 120):**
  - **Vitality:** 30
  - **Endurance:** 40
  - **Intelligence:** 40
  - **Faith:** 40
  - **Strength/Dexterity:** 16-20 (for weapons)
- **Rings:**
  - **Great Swamp Ring** (Boosts Pyro damage)
  - **Flame Stoneplate Ring +2** (More FP)
  - **Sage Ring +2** (More casts)
  - **Prisoner’s Chain** (Extra stats)
- **Armor:**
  - **Sage’s Big Hat + Crown of Dusk** (Max spell damage)
  - **Black Witch Set** (Fashion)
- **Best for:** PvE (Great Chaos Fireball melts bosses), PvP (Black Flame combos, melee + Pyro mix)

---

### **Honorable Mentions:**
- **Bleed Luck Build (SL 90-120)**
  - **Weapons:** Hollow-infused **Anri’s Straight Sword** / **Warden Twinblades**
  - **Stats:** 40 Dex, 40 Luck, 30-40 Vitality
  - **Rings:** **Prisoner’s Chain, Chloranthy, Leo, Carthus Milkring**
  - **Best for:** PvP (bleed procs in 2-3 hits)

- **Hybrid Quality Build (Str/Dex)**
  - **Weapons:** **Claymore, Gargoyle’s Halberd, Black Knight Sword**
  - **Stats:** 40 Str / 40 Dex
  - **Best for:** Versatile PvE & PvP

- **Tank Build (Ultra Greatswords)**
  - **Weapons:** **LSThis (Lothric Sword in DS3, but in DS1: Greatsword of Artorias, Black Knight Greatsword)**
  - **Stats:** 60+ Vitality, 50+ Endurance, 30+ Strength

---

### **Best for Pure PvE (Boss Killing)**
- **Demon’s Greataxe (50 Str)** – Highest single-hit AR
- **Chaos Fire Whip + Great Chaos Fireball** – Melts bosses like Bed of Chaos, Seath
- **CMW Buffed Greatsword** – High DPS
- **Bleed Uchigatana (40 Dex / 40 Luck)** – ORNG city bosses like Artorias

### **Best for PvP (Meta SL 120-125)**
- **Dark Bead Hex Build** (50 Faith / 50 Int) – One-shots with Hornet Ring ripostes
- **Hornet Ring + Rgele’s Rapier** – Best backstab damage
- **Black Flame Pyro** – Unavoidable damage
- **Bleed Luck Build** – Anri’s Sword + Carthus Rouge

---
### **Final Verdict:**
- **Best All-Around:** **Quality Build (40 Str / 40 Dex)** – Versatile for PvE & PvP
- **Best for PvE Damage:** **Chaos Pyromancy or CMW Int Build**
- **Best for PvP:** **Bleed Luck (Anri’s Sword) or Hornet Ring Crit Build**
- **Best Tank:** **50+ Vitality Greataxe/Ultragreatsword Build**
